command:
set -e; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/scripts/final-e2e-contract-fix-v1.py > /tmp/final-e2e-contract-fix-v1.py; python3 /tmp/final-e2e-contract-fix-v1.py; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('apps/mobile/e2e/responsive.spec.ts')
s=p.read_text()

pnpm exec prettier --write apps/mobile/e2e/responsive.spec.ts; git diff --check; pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile exec playwright test -c playwright.config.ts --reporter=line; pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile lint; pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile typecheck; echo E2E_CONTRACT_FIX_V2_OK
